discovery_scope: Canonical default public blog article URLs from the dedicated blog sitemap, reconciled with verified historical inventory. Product, course, case study and documentation maps were parsed but excluded from article scope.
terminal_evidence: All 328 URL elements in the dedicated sitemap were parsed, yielding 327 article routes after excluding the blog root. The root sitemap graph was exhausted. This establishes publisher declared blog discoverability, not lifetime completeness or the current client archive's pagination semantics.
gaps: Sixteen routes are video posts with short article containers and embedded media. Public HTML was fetched, but substantive prose extraction and media transcript coverage are unavailable.

The initial classifier mislabeled two real MySQL tutorials as challenges because their prose said access denied. The original events remain, and corrected classifier retries retrieved both substantive bodies.
Guessed feed and sitemap alias endpoints returned HTTP 404. The actual declared sitemap and RSS endpoints succeeded.
The current blog archive yielded no article links to the generic HTML parser, so an empty archive extraction was not treated as proof of exhaustion.
